tasks.title: Sec A · 第 1 组
tasks.context: Questions 1 to 4 are based on the conversation you have just heard.

questions.stem: What does the woman say about the new laws in Italy?

options.A: They reward businesses that eliminate food waste.
options.B: They prohibit the sale of foods that have gone stale.
options.C: They facilitate the donation of unsold foods to the needy.
options.D: They forbid businesses to produce more foods than needed.

questions.cn: 关于意大利的新法律，女士说了什么？

optionsCn.A: 它们奖励消除食物浪费的企业。
optionsCn.B: 它们禁止销售变质的食品。
optionsCn.C: 它们为把卖不出去的食物捐给穷困者提供便利。
optionsCn.D: 它们禁止企业生产超出需要的食品。

questions.stem: What did the European Parliament do to reduce food waste?

options.A: It imposed penalties on businesses that waste food.
options.B: It passed a law aiming to stop overproduction.
options.C: It voted against food import from outside Europe.
options.D: It prohibited the promotion of bulk food sales.

questions.cn: 欧洲议会为减少食物浪费做了什么？

optionsCn.A: 它对浪费食物的企业施加处罚。
optionsCn.B: 它通过了一项旨在制止生产过剩的法律。
optionsCn.C: 它投票反对从欧洲以外进口食品。
optionsCn.D: 它禁止推广散装食品销售。

questions.stem: What has the French government done recently?

options.A: It has warmed its people against possible food shortage.
options.B: It has penalized businesses that keep overproducing foods.
options.C: It has started a nationwide campaign against food waste.
options.D: It has banned supermarkets from dumping edible foods.

questions.cn: 法国政府最近做了什么？

optionsCn.A: 它告诫民众警惕可能出现的食物短缺。
optionsCn.B: 它处罚了持续生产过剩食品的企业。
optionsCn.C: 它发起了一场全国性的反食物浪费运动。
optionsCn.D: 它禁止超市丢弃仍可食用的食品。

questions.stem: What is the major cause of food waste in the United States?

options.A: The confusion over food expiration labels.
options.B: The surplus resulting from overproduction.
options.C: Americans' habit of buying food in bulk.
options.D: A lack of regulation on food consumption.

questions.cn: 美国食物浪费的主要原因是什么？

optionsCn.A: 对食品保质期标签的困惑。
optionsCn.B: 生产过剩造成的剩余。
optionsCn.C: 美国人大量囤购食品的习惯。
optionsCn.D: 对食品消费缺乏监管。

lines.t: Conversation 1.
lines.cn: 对话一。

lines.t: M: And now, for the lighter side of the news, Europe is setting an example for the rest of the world when it comes to food waste.
lines.cn: M：现在来看轻松一些的新闻：在减少食物浪费方面，欧洲正在为世界其他国家树立榜样。

lines.t: F: That's right, John.
lines.cn: F：没错，约翰。

lines.t: F: This week, the Italian government passed legislation that aimed to dramatically reduce the amount of food wasted in the country.
lines.cn: F：本周，意大利政府通过了旨在大幅减少国内食物浪费量的立法。

lines.t: F: New laws have been put into place that will make it easier for farms and supermarkets to donate unsold foods to those who are in need.
lines.cn: F：新法律已经生效，农场和超市将更容易把卖不出去的食物捐给有需要的人。

lines.t: M: Yes, and in addition to this, businesses will now be rewarded for successful efforts to cut food waste.
lines.cn: M：是的，除此之外，企业如果成功减少食物浪费，现在还会得到奖励。

lines.t: M: Italy is not the only country to focus on reducing food waste.
lines.cn: M：意大利并不是唯一关注减少食物浪费的国家。

lines.t: M: Just earlier this year, the European Parliament voted in favour of legislation that would stop grocery giants from unfair trading practices that result in overproduction, thus creating waste.
lines.cn: M：就在今年早些时候，欧洲议会投票通过了一项立法，禁止食品零售巨头采取导致生产过剩、从而造成浪费的不公平交易做法。

lines.t: F: In France, the government has banned supermarkets from throwing away edible foods and imposed harsh penalties on businesses that fail to comply with the regulations.
lines.cn: F：在法国，政府已禁止超市丢弃仍可食用的食品，并对不遵守规定的企业施加严厉处罚。

lines.t: F: While there is still much progress to be made, other countries could learn a thing or two from the example set by France and Italy.
lines.cn: F：尽管还有很大进步空间，其他国家可以从法国和意大利树立的榜样中学到一些东西。

lines.t: M: In the United States, up to 40% of all food goes uneaten, despite the fact that one in seven American households lacks regular access to good food.
lines.cn: M：在美国，多达 40% 的食物没被吃掉，尽管每七个美国家庭就有一个无法稳定获得优质食物。

lines.t: M: One major cause of this problem is the confusion over food expiration labels, which are currently not regulated by the government.
lines.cn: M：造成这一问题的一个主要原因是对食品保质期标签的困惑，这些标签目前并不受政府监管。

lines.t: F: All this could change soon.
lines.cn: F：这一切可能很快就会改变。

lines.t: F: This wave of new laws in Europe will definitely put more pressure on lawmakers to reduce food waste here.
lines.cn: F：欧洲这一波新法律肯定会给立法者施加更大压力，促使他们在这里也减少食物浪费。

lines.t: M: We turn now to a spokesperson from Harvard University's Food Law and Policy Clinic for more on this story.
lines.cn: M：现在我们请哈佛大学食品法与政策诊所的一位发言人来进一步解读这条新闻。

lines.t: F: And now, let's welcome Professor Edward Baker to speak to us.
lines.cn: F：现在，让我们欢迎爱德华·贝克教授为我们讲话。

tasks.title: Sec A · 第 2 组
tasks.context: Questions 5 to 8 are based on the conversation you have just heard.

questions.stem: What do we learn about Saks Department Store?

options.A: It has started a week-long promotion campaign.
options.B: It has just launched its annual anniversary sales.
options.C: It offers regular weekend sales all the year round.
options.D: It specializes in the sale of ladies designer dresses.

questions.cn: 关于萨克斯百货商店，我们了解到什么？

optionsCn.A: 它开始了为期一周的促销活动。
optionsCn.B: 它刚刚启动了一年一度的周年庆促销。
optionsCn.C: 它全年定期举办周末促销。
optionsCn.D: 它专营女式设计师款连衣裙。

questions.stem: What does the man say Saks Department Store offers?

options.A: Price reductions for its frequent customers.
options.B: Coupons for customers with bulk purchases.
options.C: Free delivery of purchases for senior customers.
options.D: Price adjustments within seven days of purchase.

questions.cn: 男士说萨克斯百货商店提供什么？

optionsCn.A: 为常客降价。
optionsCn.B: 为大量购买的顾客提供优惠券。
optionsCn.C: 为年长顾客免费送货。
optionsCn.D: 购买后七天内的调价补差。

questions.stem: What does the woman want the store to do to address the price difference?

options.A: Mail a gift card to her.
options.B: Allow her to buy on credit.
options.C: Credit it to her account.
options.D: Give her some coupons.

questions.cn: 女士希望商店如何处理差价？

optionsCn.A: 给她邮寄礼品卡。
optionsCn.B: 允许她赊购。
optionsCn.C: 把差价退到她的账户。
optionsCn.D: 给她一些优惠券。

questions.stem: What is the service Saks Department Store offers in addition to the promotion sale?

options.A: Refunding for goods returned.
options.B: Free installing of appliances.
options.C: Prolonged goods warranty.
options.D: Complimentary tailoring.

questions.cn: 除促销之外，萨克斯百货商店还提供什么服务？

optionsCn.A: 退货退款。
optionsCn.B: 免费安装家电。
optionsCn.C: 延长商品保修期。
optionsCn.D: 免费改衣。

lines.t: Conversation 2.
lines.cn: 对话二。

lines.t: M: Thank you for calling Saks Fifth Avenue Department Store.
lines.cn: M：感谢您致电萨克斯第五大道百货商店。

lines.t: M: How can I be of assistance to you today?
lines.cn: M：今天有什么可以为您效劳的？

lines.t: F: Hello.
lines.cn: F：你好。

lines.t: F: I was in your store this past weekend and bought a few items.
lines.cn: F：我上周末在你们店里买了几件东西。

lines.t: F: Yesterday, my friend told me that the annual anniversary sales had begun.
lines.cn: F：昨天我朋友告诉我，一年一度的周年庆促销开始了。

lines.t: F: It turned out she bought the same sweater as I did, but for a much lower price.
lines.cn: F：结果她买了和我一模一样的毛衣，但价格便宜得多。

lines.t: M: Yes, our anniversary sales started on Monday.
lines.cn: M：是的，我们的周年庆促销周一开始。

lines.t: M: We do offer price adjustments within seven days of purchase to ensure our customers' satisfaction.
lines.cn: M：为确保顾客满意，我们提供购买后七天内调价补差的服务。

lines.t: M: You said you did the purchase here this past weekend?
lines.cn: M：您说您上周末在我们这儿买的？

lines.t: F: Yes, I was shopping in your store last Sunday afternoon.
lines.cn: F：是的，我上周日下午在你们店里购物。

lines.t: M: That would definitely fall within the price adjustment window.
lines.cn: M：那肯定在调价补差的时间范围内。

lines.t: M: Do you have an account with us?
lines.cn: M：您在我们这里开有账户吗？

lines.t: M: We could credit your account directly with the difference, if you wish.
lines.cn: M：如果您愿意，我们可以直接把差价退到您的账户里。

lines.t: M: Otherwise, we can send a gift card by mail, if you prefer.
lines.cn: M：或者，如果您更喜欢的话，我们可以邮寄一张礼品卡给您。

lines.t: F: Crediting my account would be wonderful, thank you.
lines.cn: F：退到我的账户就太好了，谢谢。

lines.t: F: Now that you mention there's a sale going on, I do remember a dress I quite liked when I was in the shop on Sunday.
lines.cn: F：既然你提到正在促销，我想起周日逛店时我挺喜欢的一条裙子。

lines.t: F: Is it on offer as well?
lines.cn: F：那条裙子也在促销吗？

lines.t: M: Yes, ma'am.
lines.cn: M：是的，女士。

lines.t: M: All the new arrivals are 15-20% off.
lines.cn: M：所有新款都打 85 到 8 折。

lines.t: M: In addition to the sale, we are running a promotion for complimentary tailoring, if needed.
lines.cn: M：除促销之外，我们还推出免费改衣服务，如有需要。

lines.t: F: That's good news.
lines.cn: F：这真是个好消息。

lines.t: F: The dress really caught my eye, but I did have some concerns about the length.
lines.cn: F：那条裙子确实很吸引我，但我对裙长有些顾虑。

lines.t: F: How long will the alterations take?
lines.cn: F：改衣需要多长时间？

lines.t: M: Our tailoring department guarantees alterations to be completed within five working days.
lines.cn: M：我们的改衣部门保证在五个工作日内完成修改。

lines.t: M: If you'd like, I can set one aside for you.
lines.cn: M：如果您愿意，我可以为您留一条。

lines.t: M: If you're able to come in this afternoon, you can give your name to the sales manager and they will be able to assist you.
lines.cn: M：如果您今天下午能过来，把名字告诉销售经理，他们就能帮您办理。

questions.stem: What do we know about the original Barbie dolls?

options.A: They are thin, tall, and unlike real human beings.
options.B: They have more than twenty different hair textures.
options.C: They have twenty-four different body shapes in total.
options.D: They represent people from virtually all walks of life.

questions.cn: 关于原版芭比娃娃，我们了解到什么？

optionsCn.A: 她们又瘦又高，不像真实的人。
optionsCn.B: 她们有二十多种不同的发质。
optionsCn.C: 她们总共有 24 种不同的体型。
optionsCn.D: 她们几乎代表了各行各业的人。

questions.stem: Why do some people feel unsatisfied with the new Barbie dolls?

options.A: They do not reflect young girls' aspirations.
options.B: They are not sold together with the original.
options.C: Their flat feet do not appeal to adolescents.
options.D: Their body shapes have not changed much.

questions.cn: 为什么有些人对新款芭比娃娃不满意？

optionsCn.A: 它们没有反映年轻女孩的向往。
optionsCn.B: 它们没有与原版一起销售。
optionsCn.C: 它们的平底脚不吸引青少年。
optionsCn.D: 它们的体型变化不大。

questions.stem: Where will the new Barbie dolls be sold first?

options.A: In toy stores.
options.B: In shopping malls.
options.C: On the Internet.
options.D: At Barbie shops.

questions.cn: 新款芭比娃娃将首先在哪里销售？

optionsCn.A: 在玩具店。
optionsCn.B: 在购物中心。
optionsCn.C: 在互联网上。
optionsCn.D: 在芭比专卖店。

lines.t: Passage 1.
lines.cn: 短文一。

lines.t: Barbie dolls have a particular look to them.
lines.cn: 芭比娃娃有着独特的外形。

lines.t: They are thin, tall, long-legged, and virtually unlike any real human being.
lines.cn: 她们瘦、高、腿长，几乎与任何真实的人都不一样。

lines.t: Although, over the years, Barbie has had more than 180 different careers, including football coach, sign language teacher, ambassador, president, and astronaut.
lines.cn: 不过，多年来芭比有过 180 多种不同的职业，包括橄榄球教练、手语教师、大使、总统和宇航员。

lines.t: Her body shape hasn't changed much.
lines.cn: 她的体型却没有太大变化。

lines.t: Last year, Mattel, the company that makes Barbie dolls, added some Barbies to its line that have different skin tones and hair textures.
lines.cn: 去年，生产芭比娃娃的美泰公司在产品线中增加了一些肤色和发质各异的芭比。

lines.t: There are now Barbies with one of seven skin tones, 22 eye colours, and 24 hairstyles to choose from.
lines.cn: 现在可供选择的芭比有 7 种肤色、22 种眼睛颜色和 24 种发型。

lines.t: Last year, Mattel also gave Barbie a flat foot, rather than forcing her to be in heels all the time like the original Barbie is.
lines.cn: 去年，美泰还让芭比有了平底脚，不再像最初版芭比那样总是被迫穿着高跟鞋。

lines.t: Now, they are introducing new Barbies with three slightly different body shapes, while the original tall and thin Barbies will continue to be sold.
lines.cn: 现在，他们推出了三种体型略有不同的新芭比，而原本高瘦的芭比仍将继续销售。

lines.t: In a statement on its website, the company says it wants Barbies to look more like real people, and to give girls everywhere infinitely more ways to spark their imagination and play out their stories.
lines.cn: 公司在官网上的一份声明中说，它希望芭比看起来更像真实的人，也让世界各地的女孩有更多方式激发想象力、演绎她们的故事。

lines.t: Although many people say the new Barbies are a step in the right direction, some people say they don't go far enough.
lines.cn: 尽管许多人说新芭比是朝着正确方向迈出的一步，但也有人说这还不够。

lines.t: They say that the new body shapes could be even more different from the original tall, thin Barbies.
lines.cn: 他们说，新体型本可以与原版高瘦芭比有更大的差别。

lines.t: Sales of Barbie dolls have been falling every year since 2012, according to CBC News.
lines.cn: 据加拿大广播公司新闻报道，自 2012 年以来，芭比娃娃的销量每年都在下滑。

lines.t: The toys aren't in stores yet, but they will be sold online at the Barbie website, starting this week, for $9.
lines.cn: 这些玩具尚未进入实体店，但从本周起将在芭比官网上以 9 美元的价格出售。

tasks.title: Sec B · 第 2 组
tasks.context: Questions 12 to 15 are based on the passage you have just heard.

questions.stem: What happened in Germany around the year 1450?

options.A: Moveable metal type began to be used in printing.
options.B: Chinese printing technology was first introduced.
options.C: The earliest known book was published.
options.D: Metal type was imported from Korea.

questions.cn: 大约 1450 年在德国发生了什么？

optionsCn.A: 活字金属印刷开始被使用。
optionsCn.B: 中国印刷技术首次被引入。
optionsCn.C: 已知最早的书籍出版。
optionsCn.D: 金属活字从朝鲜进口。

questions.stem: What does the speaker say about the printer Plantain of Antwerp?

options.A: It had more than a hundred printing presses.
options.B: It was the biggest printer in the 16th century.
options.C: It helped the German people become literate.
options.D: It produced some 20 million volumes in total.

questions.cn: 关于安特卫普的印刷商普朗坦，讲话者说了什么？

optionsCn.A: 它拥有 100 多台印刷机。
optionsCn.B: 它是 16 世纪最大的印刷商。
optionsCn.C: 它帮助德国人识字。
optionsCn.D: 它总共印制了约 2000 万册书。

questions.stem: What was the immediate effect of printing?

options.A: It pushed handwritten books out of circulation.
options.B: It boosted the circulation of popular works.
options.C: It made writing a very profitable career.
options.D: It provided readers with more choices.

questions.cn: 印刷术的直接效果是什么？

optionsCn.A: 它把手抄本书籍挤出了流通。
optionsCn.B: 它提升了受欢迎作品的传播量。
optionsCn.C: 它使写作成为非常赚钱的职业。
optionsCn.D: 它为读者提供了更多选择。

questions.stem: What was the great cultural impact of printing?

options.A: It accelerated the extinction of the Latin language.
options.B: It standardized the publication of grammar books.
options.C: It turned translation into a welcome profession.
options.D: It promoted the growth of national languages.

questions.cn: 印刷术巨大的文化影响是什么？

optionsCn.A: 它加速了拉丁语的消亡。
optionsCn.B: 它规范了语法书的出版。
optionsCn.C: 它使翻译成为受欢迎的职业。
optionsCn.D: 它促进了各民族语言的发展。

lines.t: Passage 2.
lines.cn: 短文二。

lines.t: The earliest printed book we know today appeared in China in the year 868, and metal type was in use in Korea at the beginning of the 15th century.
lines.cn: 我们今天所知最早的印刷书籍于公元 868 年出现在中国，而金属活字在 15 世纪初已在朝鲜使用。

lines.t: But it was in Germany, around the year 1450, that a printing press using movable metal type was invented.
lines.cn: 但使用金属活字的印刷机是在德国，大约 1450 年发明的。

lines.t: Capitalism turned printing from an invention into an industry.
lines.cn: 资本主义把印刷术从一项发明变成了一门产业。

lines.t: Right from the start, book printing and publishing were organised on capitalist lines.
lines.cn: 从一开始，书籍印刷和出版就是按资本主义的方式组织起来的。

lines.t: The biggest 16th century printer, Plantain of Antwerp, had 24 printing presses and employed more than 100 workers.
lines.cn: 16 世纪最大的印刷商、安特卫普的普朗坦拥有 24 台印刷机，雇用了 100 多名工人。

lines.t: Only a small fraction of the population was literate, but the production of books grew at an extraordinary speed.
lines.cn: 当时只有一小部分人识字，但书籍的产量却以惊人的速度增长。

lines.t: By 1500, some 20 million volumes had already been printed.
lines.cn: 到 1500 年，已经印出了约 2000 万册书。

lines.t: The immediate effect of printing was to increase the circulation of works that were already popular in a handwritten form, while less popular works went out of circulation.
lines.cn: 印刷术的直接效果是增加了那些以手抄本形式已经流行过的作品的传播量，而不那么受欢迎的作品则退出了流通。

lines.t: Publishers were interested only in books that would sell fairly quickly in sufficient numbers to cover the costs of production and make a profit.
lines.cn: 出版商只对能较快售出、数量足以收回生产成本并盈利的书感兴趣。

lines.t: Thus, while printing enormously increased access to books by making cheap, high-volume production possible, it also reduced choice.
lines.cn: 因此，印刷术虽然通过实现廉价、大批量生产极大地增加了人们获得书籍的机会，却也减少了选择。

lines.t: The great cultural impact of printing was that it facilitated the growth of national languages.
lines.cn: 印刷术巨大的文化影响在于，它促进了各民族语言的发展。

lines.t: Most early books were printed in Latin, but the market for Latin was limited, and in its pursuit of larger markets, the book trade soon produced translations into the national languages, emerging at the time.
lines.cn: 早期大多数书籍都用拉丁文印刷，但拉丁文市场有限；为了追求更大的市场，图书业很快推出了当时正在兴起的各民族语言的译本。

lines.t: Printing indeed played a key role in standardizing and stabilizing these languages by fixing them in print and producing dictionaries and grammar books.
lines.cn: 印刷术确实在规范和稳定这些语言方面发挥了关键作用：它把这些语言固定为印刷文本，并催生了词典和语法书。

tasks.title: Sec C · 第 1 组
tasks.context: Questions 16 to 18 are based on the recording you have just heard.

questions.stem: What does the speaker say about many college graduates?

options.A: They get bored after working for a period of time.
options.B: They spend an average of one year finding a job.
options.C: They become stuck in the same job for decades.

questions.cn: 关于许多大学毕业生，讲话者说了什么？

lines.t: Many people graduate from school or college not knowing what to do with their lives, and get a job without really thinking about it.
lines.cn: 许多人从学校或大学毕业时并不知道自己要怎么过一生，找工作也没真正想过。

lines.t: For some, things work out fine, but others often find themselves stuck in a job they hate.
lines.cn: 有些人一切顺利，但另一些人常常发现自己卡在一份厌恶的工作里。

lines.t: Your working life lasts an average of 40 years, so it's important to find a job you like and feel enthusiastic about.
lines.cn: 你的职业生涯平均长达 40 年，所以找到一份自己喜欢、有热情的工作很重要。

lines.t: Luckily, there are many ways you can get help to do this.
lines.cn: 幸运的是，有很多途径可以帮你做到这一点。

lines.t: The Australian website, www.
lines.cn: 澳大利亚网站 www.

lines.t: careersonline.
lines.cn: careersonline.

lines.t: com, compares choosing a career with going to the movies.
lines.cn: com 把选择职业比作去看电影。

lines.t: Before you see a movie, you find out what films are showing.
lines.cn: 看电影之前，你会先了解有哪些影片在上映。

lines.t: The site suggests you should do the same with your career.
lines.cn: 该网站建议，选择职业时也应如此。

lines.t: Find out what jobs are available, and what your options are.
lines.cn: 先了解有哪些工作机会，以及你的选择有哪些。

lines.t: Next, decide which movie you like best.
lines.cn: 接下来，决定你最喜欢哪部电影。

lines.t: If you're not a romantic person, you won't want to see a love story.
lines.cn: 如果你不是浪漫的人，就不会想看爱情片。

lines.t: In other words, with your career, you should decide which job will suit your personality.
lines.cn: 换句话说，在职业上，你该决定哪种工作适合你的个性。

lines.t: Finally, decide how to get movie tickets, and find out where the theatre is before you go.
lines.cn: 最后，决定怎么买电影票，并在出发前弄清影院在哪里。

lines.t: With your career, you need to find information about where you can work, and how to get a job in that profession.
lines.cn: 在职业上，你需要找到关于在哪里能工作、以及如何在这一行业找到工作的信息。

lines.t: So, how do you start?
lines.cn: 那么，从哪里开始呢？

lines.t: Begin by asking yourself some questions.
lines.cn: 先问自己几个问题。

lines.t: Some jobs require you to have certain life experiences.
lines.cn: 有些工作要求你具备某些人生经历。

lines.t: Have you traveled overseas?
lines.cn: 你去过国外吗？

lines.t: Do you have any extra certificates besides your degree, such as a first aid license, for example?
lines.cn: 除了学位之外，你还有其他证书吗，比如急救证？

lines.t: Your physical state and build can also affect which jobs you can do.
lines.cn: 你的身体状态和体格也会影响你能从事哪些工作。

lines.t: A person, for example, who is allergic to cats would probably never become an animal doctor.
lines.cn: 比如，对猫过敏的人大概永远当不了兽医。

lines.t: Flight attendants, firefighters, and police officers have to be over a certain height, and be physically fit.
lines.cn: 空乘、消防员和警察必须超过一定身高，并且体格良好。

lines.t: Your personality matters, too.
lines.cn: 你的个性也很重要。

lines.t: Are you outgoing or shy?
lines.cn: 你外向还是害羞？

lines.t: If you like working alone, a job that requires lots of teamwork might not suit you.
lines.cn: 如果你喜欢独自工作，需要大量团队协作的工作可能就不适合你。

lines.t: Choosing a career can take time and a lot of thought.
lines.cn: 选择职业需要时间和反复思考。

lines.t: However, when you know you can look forward to working in your dream job, you'll be glad you thought it through.
lines.cn: 不过，当你知道自己能期待从事梦想中的工作，你会庆幸自己当初想清楚了。

lines.t: When you look for the right job, according to the Australian website.
lines.cn: 根据这家澳大利亚网站的说法，当你寻找合适的工作时。

lines.t: Recording 2.
lines.cn: 录音二。

lines.t: Kwanzaa is a cultural festival during which African Americans celebrate and reflect upon their rich heritage as the products of two worlds.
lines.cn: 宽扎节是一个文化节日，非裔美国人在其间庆祝并反思自己作为两个世界产物的丰富传统。

lines.t: It begins December 26th and lasts for seven days.
lines.cn: 它从 12 月 26 日开始，持续七天。

lines.t: Kwanzaa was founded in 1966 by Dr.
lines.cn: 宽扎节由卡伦加

lines.t: Karenga, a college professor and African American leader, who believed that a special holiday could help African Americans meet their goals of building strong families, learning about their history, and creating a sense of unity.
lines.cn: 博士于 1966 年创立，他是一位大学教授和非裔美国人领袖，他认为一个特别的节日能帮助非裔美国人实现建立稳固家庭、了解自身历史和营造团结意识的目标。

lines.t: After conducting extensive research in which he studied the festivals of many African groups of people, he decided that the new holiday should be a harvest or first fruits celebration, incorporating ideas from many different harvest traditions.
lines.cn: 在进行了广泛研究、考察了许多非洲族群的节日之后，他决定这个新节日应当是收获节或初果节，融合了许多不同丰收传统的理念。

lines.t: Kwanzaa is a Kiswahili word meaning the first fruits of the harvest.
lines.cn: 宽扎是一个斯瓦希里语词，意为收获的第一批果实。

lines.t: The East African language of Kiswahili was chosen as the official language of Kwanzaa because it is a non-tribal language spoken by a large portion of the African population.
lines.cn: 东非的斯瓦希里语被选为宽扎节的官方语言，因为它是一种非部落性的语言，为很大一部分非洲人口所使用。

lines.t: Also, its pronunciation is easy.
lines.cn: 而且它的发音很容易。

lines.t: Kwanzaa is based on seven principles which are unity, self-determination, collective work and responsibility, cooperative economics, purpose, creativity, and faith.
lines.cn: 宽扎节基于七项原则：团结、自主、集体劳动与责任、合作经济、目标、创造力和信念。

lines.t: One principle is highlighted each day of the holiday.
lines.cn: 节日期间每天突出强调一项原则。

lines.t: In preparation for the celebration, a straw mat is placed on the table, along with a candle holder with seven candles, one black, three red, and three green.
lines.cn: 为准备庆祝活动，桌上会铺一张草席，并放上一个插着七支蜡烛的烛台：一支黑色、三支红色、三支绿色。

lines.t: The black candle represents the African American people, the red is for their struggles, and the green represents their hopes for the future.
lines.cn: 黑色蜡烛代表非裔美国人，红色代表他们的斗争，绿色代表他们对未来的希望。

lines.t: Other items placed on the table are a variety of fruit, ears of corns, gifts, and a communal unity cup for pouring and sharing drinks.
lines.cn: 桌上还摆放着各种水果、玉米穗、礼物，以及一个用来斟酒、共饮的公共“团结杯”。

lines.t: Each day of Kwanzaa, usually before the evening meal, family and friends gather around the table and someone lights a candle, beginning with the black.
lines.cn: 宽扎节的每一天，通常在晚餐前，家人和朋友会围在桌旁，由一个人点燃蜡烛，先从黑色那支开始。

lines.t: After that, candles are lit alternately from left to right.
lines.cn: 之后，蜡烛从左到右交替点燃。

lines.t: While the candle is being lit, a principle is recited, then each person present takes a turn to speak about the importance that principle has to himself or herself.
lines.cn: 点蜡烛时，会诵读一项原则，然后在场每个人轮流谈谈这一原则对自己有多重要。

lines.t: Next, the ceremony focuses on remembering those who have died.
lines.cn: 接着，仪式转向缅怀逝去的人。

lines.t: A selected person pours water or juice from the unity cup into a bowl.
lines.cn: 由一位选定的人把团结杯里的水或果汁倒入碗中。

lines.t: That person then drinks from the cup and raises it high, saying Harambee, which means let's all pour together.
lines.cn: 随后这个人从杯中喝一口，并把杯子高高举起，说出“哈兰贝”，意思是“让我们一同倾注”。

lines.t: All repeat Harambee seven times, and each person drinks from the cup.
lines.cn: 所有人重复七遍“哈兰贝”，每个人依次从杯中饮用。

lines.t: Then, names of African American leaders and heroes are called out, and everyone reflects upon the great things these people did.
lines.cn: 然后，人们会呼喊非裔美国人领袖和英雄的名字，每个人都在心中回想他们所做的伟大事迹。

lines.t: The ceremony is followed by a meal, and then singing and perhaps listening to African music.
lines.cn: 仪式之后是用餐，然后是唱歌，也许还会听非洲音乐。

lines.t: Recording 3.
lines.cn: 录音三。

lines.t: The Mediterranean diet is based upon the eating patterns of traditional cultures in the Mediterranean region.
lines.cn: 地中海饮食以地中海地区传统文化中的饮食模式为基础。

lines.t: Several noted nutritionists and research projects have concluded that this diet is one of the most healthful in the world in terms of preventing such illnesses as heart disease and cancer, and increasing life expectancy.
lines.cn: 多位知名营养学家和多个研究项目得出结论：就预防心脏病、癌症等疾病以及延长寿命而言，这种饮食是世界上最健康的饮食之一。

lines.t: The countries that have inspired the Mediterranean diet all surround the Mediterranean Sea.
lines.cn: 启发了地中海饮食的这些国家都环绕着地中海。

lines.t: These cultures have eating habits that developed over thousands of years.
lines.cn: 这些文化的饮食习惯是经过数千年发展形成的。

lines.t: In Europe, parts of Italy, Greece, Portugal, Spain, and southern France adhere to principles of the Mediterranean diet, as do Morocco and Tunisia in North Africa.
lines.cn: 在欧洲，意大利、希腊、葡萄牙、西班牙的部分地区和法国南部遵循地中海饮食的原则，北非的摩洛哥和突尼斯也是如此。

lines.t: Parts of the Balkan region and Turkey follow the diet, as well as Middle Eastern countries like Lebanon and Syria.
lines.cn: 巴尔干部分地区、土耳其，以及黎巴嫩和叙利亚等中东国家也遵循这种饮食。

lines.t: The Mediterranean region is warm and sunny, and produces large supplies of fresh fruits and vegetables almost year-round that people eat many times a day.
lines.cn: 地中海地区温暖多阳光，几乎全年都能出产大量新鲜水果和蔬菜，人们每天要吃很多次。

lines.t: Wine, bread, olive oil, and nuts are other staples of the region, and the Mediterranean Sea has historically yielded abundant quantities of fish.
lines.cn: 葡萄酒、面包、橄榄油和坚果是该地区的其他主要食物，而地中海历来盛产鱼类。

lines.t: International interest in the therapeutic qualities of the Mediterranean diet began back in the late 1950s, when medical researchers started to link the occurrence of heart disease with diet.
lines.cn: 国际上对地中海饮食疗愈价值的兴趣始于 20 世纪 50 年代末，当时医学研究人员开始把心脏病的发生与饮食联系起来。

lines.t: Dr.
lines.cn: 安塞尔·基斯

lines.t: Ancel Keys performed an epidemiological analysis of diets around the world.
lines.cn: 博士对世界各地的饮食进行了流行病学分析。

lines.t: Entitled The Seven-Country Study, it is considered one of the greatest studies of its kind ever performed.
lines.cn: 这项名为“七国研究”的研究被认为是同类研究中最重要的研究之一。

lines.t: In it, Keys gathered data on heart disease and its potential causes from nearly 13,000 men in Greece, Italy, Croatia, Serbia, Japan, Finland, the Netherlands, and the United States.
lines.cn: 在研究中，基斯收集了来自希腊、意大利、克罗地亚、塞尔维亚、日本、芬兰、荷兰和美国近 1.3 万名男性的心脏病及其潜在病因数据。

lines.t: The study was conducted over a period of decades.
lines.cn: 这项研究持续进行了数十年。

lines.t: It concluded that the Mediterranean people in the study enjoyed some significant health advantages.
lines.cn: 研究得出结论：研究中的地中海地区人群享有显著的健康优势。

lines.t: The Mediterranean groups had lower mortality rates in all age brackets and from all causes, particularly from heart disease.
lines.cn: 地中海地区各组的死亡率在所有年龄段、各种死因上都更低，尤其是心脏病致死率。

lines.t: The study also showed that the Mediterranean diet is as high or higher in fat than other diets, obtaining up to 40% of all its calories from fat.
lines.cn: 研究还表明，地中海饮食的脂肪含量与其他饮食相当甚至更高，其热量的 40% 来自脂肪。

lines.t: It has, however, different patterns of fat intake.
lines.cn: 不过，它的脂肪摄入结构有所不同。

lines.t: Mediterranean cooking uses smaller amounts of saturated fat and higher amounts of unsaturated fat, mostly in the form of olive oil.
lines.cn: 地中海式烹饪使用较少的饱和脂肪和较多的不饱和脂肪，后者主要以橄榄油的形式摄入。

lines.t: Saturated fats are fats that are found principally in meat and dairy products, although some nuts and vegetable oils also contain them.
lines.cn: 饱和脂肪主要存在于肉类和乳制品中，虽然一些坚果和植物油也含有。

lines.t: Saturated fats are used by the body to make cholesterol, and high levels of cholesterol have since been directly related to heart disease.
lines.cn: 人体用饱和脂肪合成胆固醇，而高胆固醇水平此后被证明与心脏病直接相关。
